Acme Kettle K2

The K2 is our quietest kettle yet. It boils a full jug in under four minutes, keeps water warm for half an hour, and switches itself off when the jug runs dry. The handle stays cool and the lid opens with one finger.

Every K2 ships with a two year warranty and free returns within thirty days of delivery, no questions asked.

Capacity:1.7 litres
Power:3000 W
Release date:2026-03-02
